changes.to: The maker site (hfun-tech.com) lists HM01 only; no T01 product page or datasheet was found on 2026-11-17, so spec fields stay empty. Zhejiang provincial government news (21 Aug 2026) and Korean trade press report T01 unveiled at WRC 2026 on 20 Aug 2026: 30 kg body, leg-arm reuse cutting core parts by nearly half, four modes (biped, wheeled, ride-on chair, stowed carrier), ride mode up to 10 km/h. Locomotion recorded as Legged because bipedal walking is the primary working mode.
HFun-Tech's transformable T01, whose two limbs act as wheels, legs, chair handles or a carrier so one body serves as biped, wheeled robot, mobility chair and luggage.
